dedupe_keys.name: la palma electricity network supports substations high and medium voltage lines of the island cabildo de la palma source endesa unelco

description: This ArcGIS feature service from the Cabildo of La Palma in the Canary Islands maps the electricity network of the island, with ENDESA-UNELCO named as the source and 2015 as the data year. It has six layers: 107 line supports with coordinates, elevation and maintenance area; three substations with owner and operator fields; an underground circuit and two circuits with voltage, status and owner; 3,361 medium-voltage line segments; and a high-voltage line layer, the last two carried over from CAD with drawing attributes. The item was last modified on 1 March 2024 and is listed on the Esri Spain open data portal. Data are available free online through the feature service, with the usual export options, under the Cabildo legal notice on access and use. Coverage is La Palma island. Caveats: the network dates from 2015, before the 2021 Cumbre Vieja eruption that destroyed infrastructure on the island, and the line layers converted from CAD have few electrical attributes. Simulation uses are island grid topology for volcanic, wildfire and isolated-system resilience studies. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
